bodyText.heading: Looking for Accommodation in Heidelberg?
bodyText.text: At Alpha Aktiv, we strive to be your first point of contact when it comes to accommodation. We help you finding an accommodation. You can choose from student dormitories and apartments in Heidelberg, or we can arrange host families. We have successfully worked together with our host families for many years.

bodyText.heading: Alpha Aktiv Student Residence Heidelberg
bodyText.text: We offer our students different accommodation options in Heidelberg. There are three buildings in the city center of Heidelberg and one in the idyllic district of Ziegelhausen, in which single and double rooms are available for our students. In the dormitory, we give you a couple of options. You can either live alone or with another student in a room and share the bathroom and kitchen with the other residents on the same floor. In the dormitory, you will quickly make friends with other international students and you can use this opportunity to directly apply the German language skills you have learned in class.

bodyText.heading: Alpha Aktiv Apartments Heidelberg
bodyText.text: Aside from the student dormitories, there is also the possibility of staying in apartments. Each apartment has its own bathroom and kitchenette inside. In addition to the one-room apartments, used as single or double-room apartments, we also offer two-room flats.

bodyText.heading: Alpha Aktiv Host Families
bodyText.text: Our host families are an alternative to accommodation in a student dormitory or an apartment. Living with a host family selected by us offers the best opportunity to get to know the German way of life and hospitality and improve your language skills by practicing everyday phrases in exchange with native speakers. Accommodation is usually half board (breakfast and dinner) but can be adjusted according to your wishes.
